title: Recap Charlotte Hornets 97-111 Atlanta Hawks (Game 2)
description: Recap NBA Playoffs 2026 — Charlotte Hornets vs Atlanta Hawks (97-111) di —, 21 November 2026.
body_md:
## Atlanta Hawks Menang 111-97, Unggul 2-0 atas Charlotte Hornets

Atlanta Hawks mengakhiri pertandingan dengan kemenangan 111-97 atas Charlotte Hornets, Sabtu 21 November 2026. Dua laga, dua menang, ATL kini unggul 2-0 dalam regular season series ini.

Jalen Johnson jadi pemimpin di sisi Atlanta. 26 poin, 6 rebound, 6 asis dengan efisiensi shooting yang sulit dibantah: 10-15 from field, 3-4 dari garis tiga angka. Di sampingnya, Aaron Wiggins menyumbang 19 poin (7-12 FG, 4-6 from three) dan Nickeil Alexander-Walker 17 poin meski butuh 7-20 field goal attempts untuk sampai ke sana.

Yang membuat perbedaan bukan hanya Johnson, Dyson Daniels tampil sebagai playmaker dengan 10 asis, 8 rebound, 11 poin. Double-double dengan kontribusi dua arah.

---

## Charlotte: Rebound Unggul, Tapi Efisiensi Bermasalah

Di sisi Hornets, Moussa Diabate tampil solid: 21 poin, 15 rebound, efisiensi 9-12 from field. Angka yang seharusnya bisa jadi fondasi kemenangan, tapi tim secara kolektif tidak mendukungnya.

Brandon Miller 19 poin (7-18 FG, 5-13 from three). Naz Reid 12 poin, 10 rebound, tapi harus menembak 4-19 dari lapangan, 2-10 dari garis tiga. Coby White mengumpulkan 9 asis dari 11 poin, tapi tim secara keseluruhan melepas 17 turnover berbanding 11 milik ATL.

Charlotte sebenarnya menang di papan rebound: 49-37. Poin di paint pun nyaris setara, 50-56. Tapi angka-angka itu tidak cukup menutup lubang yang dibuat sendiri.

---

## Efisiensi yang Berbicara Keras

Dua angka dari team stats merangkum laga ini dengan ringkas.

FG%: CHA 40%, ATL 51%. Three-point shooting: CHA 24% (11-45), ATL 39% (13-33). Charlotte melepas 45 three-point attempts, 12 lebih banyak dari ATL, tapi dengan tingkat konversi yang jauh lebih rendah. Fast-break points memperlebar jarak: ATL mencetak 21, CHA hanya 10.

Steals juga satu arah, ATL 12, CHA 4. Turnover CHA yang 17 kali berulang jadi bahan bakar untuk fast break Atlanta.

---

## Momentum Q3 yang Menentukan

Key plays mencatat persaingan ketat di awal laga. Q1 masih terbuka: Diabate layup di menit 7:19 menyamakan skor 11-11. Masuk Q3, skor masih bersaing di 62-63 saat Wiggins dunk di menit 7:02. Reid jawab dengan three-pointer untuk membalik ke 65-63. Tapi Johnson tutup itu dengan three-pointer sendiri, 65-68, dan ATL tidak lagi tertinggal.

Momentum bergeser di sana, dan Charlotte tidak pernah benar-benar kembali.

---

## Selanjutnya

ATL unggul 2-0 dalam series ini dengan dua laga tersisa. Jika form ini terjaga, terutama efisiensi Johnson dan distribusi Daniels, Charlotte butuh jawaban serius untuk membalik arah series. Laga berikutnya bisa disaksikan live di NBA League Pass dan Vidio.

qc_review.headline_comment: Clear and informative but flat — 'Recap Charlotte Hornets 97-111 Atlanta Hawks (Game 2)' reads like a filename, not a headline that earns a click.
qc_review.lead_comment: Gets the score, date, and series state in cleanly but opens with 'mengakhiri pertandingan dengan kemenangan' which is wordy filler; could lead with the angle instead of the recap formula.
qc_review.structure_comment: Solid four-section structure (ATL win, CHA problems, efficiency, Q3 momentum, next) that flows forward without looping — strongest element of the piece.
qc_review.voice_comment: Mostly on-register but leans analytical-neutral; some stiff phrasings like 'efisiensi shooting yang sulit dibantah' and 'tingkat konversi yang jauh lebih rendah' drift academic.
qc_review.summary: Solid, accurate recap with good structural bones and clean use of numeric anchors, but undersells the two best stories in the data (Daniels near-triple-double, Diabate as Charlotte's lone bright spot) and the headline/title is a filename rather than a hook. Worth a quick editor pass rather than regenerate.

suggestions.issue: Title is descriptive but has zero angle — and labels this as Game 2 while the input says Game 3 of 4 with ATL already leading 2-0.
suggestions.fix: Rewrite around the angle: 'Jalen Johnson 26 Poin, Hawks Kunci Kemenangan Kedua 111-97 atas Hornets' — and verify game number against input (series state says Game 3, not Game 2).

suggestions.snippet: Yang membuat perbedaan bukan hanya Johnson, Dyson Daniels tampil sebagai playmaker dengan 10 asis, 8 rebound, 11 poin. Double-double dengan kontribusi dua arah.
suggestions.issue: Daniels had 10 ast + 8 reb + 11 pts — that's a near triple-double, not just a double-double, and the piece undersells it. Also 'kontribusi dua arah' is vague filler when Daniels led the team in steals territory (ATL had 12 team steals, Daniels is their defensive engine).
suggestions.fix: Call it what it is: 'Daniels nyaris triple-double — 11 poin, 10 asis, 8 rebound' and tie it to ATL's 12 steals vs CHA's 4 to make the defensive point concrete.

suggestions.snippet: Charlotte sebenarnya menang di papan rebound: 49-37. Poin di paint pun nyaris setara, 50-56.
suggestions.issue: Missed opportunity: Diabate alone had 15 of those 49 rebounds (nearly a third) on 9-12 shooting — the story of a lone bright spot carrying the glass is stronger than a team-level stat drop.
suggestions.fix: Lead the Charlotte section with Diabate as the isolated bright spot: 'Diabate hampir sendirian di sisi positif Charlotte — 21 poin efisien 9-12, plus 15 dari 49 rebound tim.'

suggestions.snippet: Coby White mengumpulkan 9 asis dari 11 poin
suggestions.issue: Phrasing 'asis dari 11 poin' is grammatically awkward — assists don't come 'from' points.
suggestions.fix: Rewrite as 'Coby White 11 poin dan 9 asis' — simpler and natural.

suggestions.fix: Expand this sequence by one beat, name the assister on Johnson's three (Daniels), and move the section higher — it's more engaging than the dry efficiency breakdown that currently sits above it.
